verdict: The target disk is out of space. The current operation (cache write, MSI extract, log write) could not complete.
fix: From the client: `Get-CimInstance Win32_LogicalDisk | Select DeviceID, @{N='FreeGB';E={[math]::Round($_.FreeSpace/1GB,1)}}, @{N='TotalGB';E={[math]::Round($_.Size/1GB,1)}}`. Clear obvious offenders: `%temp%`, old `%windir%\SoftwareDistribution\Download`, stale CCM cache (`Clear-CcmCache` from the sccmclictr or the client applet). If the client's C: is chronically small, right-size the cache via client settings and move `%temp%` to a partition with room.
